name: makna-content-operator
description: Create, monitor, and approve tenant-scoped MAKNA content jobs through the official Operator API.

interface.shortDescription: Operate MAKNA content jobs without browser steps.
interface.longDescription: Creates content planner and OPC production jobs, monitors progress, and supports explicit storyboard approval through MAKNA Operator API. Social publishing is intentionally excluded.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MAKNA Content Operator to create or monitor a content production job.
